entry_state: The participating floor is priced by replication separately from physical mortality and market probabilities. Its service and settlement histories retain loss components and investment cash separately. Variable-fee changes, risk mitigation, partial treaty coverage, loss revisions and legal modifications have distinct causes. Replacement-contract valuation and later finance treatment remain to be developed.
exit_state: Replacement premium connects removed and new obligations without inventing cash. Service loss, finance measurement, current presentation and old OCI reclassification retain separate origins. Fixed and variable benefits require different allocations; changing holdings freezes the old schedule. The binary claim example now shows why identical marginal laws can leave treaty recovery unidentified, with its general-method continuation still unread.
findings: Equivalent premium and actual additional cash are different quantities; copying the old carrying value loses the modification rule.
OCI history cannot be recomputed using current policy or current market changes. Mixed-origin early termination remains explicitly open.
The binary example derives the whole admissible dependence interval rather than silently selecting independence. No new confirmed manuscript defect.
